name: B10-0438/2026 (The Left) – The cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the cases of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and other political prisoners in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls for the release of Ali Karimli, Anar Mammadli and all people held in Azerbaijan for political reasons. It condemns their treatment and the crackdown on opposition, media and civil society. It says the European Union should publicly raise these cases and make closer EU–Azerbaijan relations depend on these releases.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states demands and criticism.
- It concerns Azerbaijan's authorities and the prisoners named, plus other detainees.
- The Parliament asks EU institutions to act and sends the text to them and to Azerbaijan.
